title: Many Cities. One Experience.
subtitle: Different departure cities. One shared experience.

storyboard.scene: Three miniature departure terminals appear on an illustrative route diagram; ribbons extend towards one shared destination.
Aircraft follow curved routes into a destination hub, drawing luminous trails behind them.
A dimensional hotel rises behind a curved road; animated coaches arrive and guests enter through a welcoming reception.
The roof lifts into an open gala scene with spotlights, guests, tables and an animated stage.
Shared branded closing card supplied by renderer.
